summary: Iteration 51 - Unpaid Price Controls and Category Analytics Dashboard Testing Complete. All 27 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend UI verified: Admin Panel has 16 tabs including new 'Price Controls' and 'Cat Analytics' tabs. Fixed MongoDB ObjectId serialization bug in payout-settings endpoint.
critical_code_review_comments: Unpaid Price Controls API (/api/admin/unpaid-price-controls) - GET returns settings with defaults (OFF by default, $5 max protocol, $10 max bundle)
Unpaid Price Controls API - PUT validates price ranges (0-99.99) and logs changes to admin_audit_log
Category Analytics API (/api/admin/category-analytics) returns comprehensive analytics with summary, top_categories, empty_categories, template_popularity
Category Analytics Trends API (/api/admin/category-analytics/trends) returns daily_categories_created and daily_results_added
Price validation in marketplace listing creation checks unpaid_price_control_enabled setting before enforcing limits
Settings init includes 4 new price control settings: unpaid_price_control_enabled, unpaid_max_protocol_price, unpaid_max_bundle_price, unpaid_can_sell

Admin Panel has 16 tabs: general, search, pricing, newsletter, users, moderation, price-controls, category-analytics, content, polls, ab-testing, optimizer, forecast, protocol-forecast, email-reports, tutorials
FIXED: MongoDB ObjectId serialization error in /api/marketplace/admin/payout-settings endpoint - excluded _id from response
updated_files: /app/tests/test_iteration51_features.py - Created comprehensive test suite for iteration 51 features
/app/backend/routes/marketplace.py - Fixed MongoDB ObjectId serialization in payout-settings endpoint
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 51 features verified: 1) Unpaid Price Controls with GET/PUT /api/admin/unpaid-price-controls - feature is OFF by default, admin can enable and set max prices for protocols ($5 default) and bundles ($10 default), 2) Category Analytics Dashboard with /api/admin/category-analytics and /api/admin/category-analytics/trends endpoints showing category performance, distribution, and trends, 3) Admin Panel now has 16 tabs including new 'Price Controls' and 'Cat Analytics' tabs, 4) Price validation in marketplace listing creation for unpaid users when controls are enabled, 5) Fixed MongoDB ObjectId serialization bug in payout-settings endpoint
